verdict.rationale: HubSpot's CRM and Custom Objects APIs allow batch retrieval of contacts and custom object records (hubspot-docs-3, hubspot-docs-17, hubspot-docs-41), which technically enables programmatic data extraction, but the evidence pack has no explicit documentation of a full-account 'export all data' feature or guarantee of open/standard formats (e.g., CSV/JSON export tool), and the import docs focus only on importing data into HubSpot, not exporting it out. Missing for 10: an explicit account-wide export/data-portability feature, documented open-format guarantees, and any confirmation of ease of full migration away from HubSpot.
